fusions.name: Bladder Burst
fusions.desc: Spits a bladder of pond gas that hits the first enemy in its path for 28 damage and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tongue Crack
fusions.desc: Your tongue cracks out at one enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Echoing Pop
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a pellet flies to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
